answer: Scale each answer's pay by how well its author grades. Check every account's last 30 sealed grades against the final verdicts, and if fewer than 55% matched, its answers pay half until it climbs back over that line. Accounts with under 10 seals pay normally. Say a farm runs 50 accounts that pass each other's junk, like a sparrow poem about island karst caves that never mentions sybils. Those votes keep losing to honest panels, so each farm account sinks under 55% and its own answers get cut. Honest graders sit near 78% and won't notice.
